components.name: Rounded Square Frame
components.description: A plain rounded square enclosure with an empty interior. Exclude all enclosed content, lettering, symbols and status marks.

components.name: R-Like Letterform
components.description: The visible mark has an upright stem, rounded upper bowl and diagonal lower leg, reading R. If confirmed, reuse letter-r-uppercase; if intended as P with a slash, reuse letter-p-uppercase and a separate slash. Exclude the frame and hold interpretation before generation.
